home.title: Your desktop, in your pocket
home.body: Pair this phone with OXESpace on your computer, on the same Wi-Fi, to follow and answer your sessions.
home.pairedBody: This phone can follow and answer your sessions on {{desktop}} while both are on the same network.

status.unreachable: Can't reach {{desktop}}. Check that it's on, on the same Wi-Fi, and that access from the phone is turned on.
status.incompatible: {{desktop}} uses a different version of OXESpace. Update the app or OXESpace on your computer.
status.notAccepted: {{desktop}} no longer accepts this phone. Unpair, then pair again.

home.revoked: {{desktop}} removed this phone. Pair again to reconnect.
home.addressHint: The computer's address on your Wi-Fi, for example 192.168.0.12. OXESpace shows it in Settings › Devices.
home.addressInvalid: Use the computer's address on your local network, like 192.168.0.12.

pairing.title: Pair with your computer
pairing.instructions: On your computer, open OXESpace › Settings › Devices, turn on the phone connection, and point the camera at the code shown there.
pairing.cameraDescription: Camera view for scanning the pairing code
pairing.cameraNeeded: The camera reads the pairing code on your computer's screen. Nothing it sees leaves the phone.
pairing.cameraDenied: Camera access is off for OXESpace. Turn it on in the phone's settings to scan the pairing code.

badCode.notPairing: That isn't an OXESpace pairing code. Point the camera at the code in Settings › Devices.
badCode.unsupportedVersion: This code comes from a different version of OXESpace. Update the app or OXESpace on your computer.
badCode.publicHost: This code points outside your local network. OXESpace only pairs on the same Wi-Fi.
badCode.malformed: This code can't be read. Show a new one on your computer and try again.

pairing.waitingBody: {{desktop}} is asking whether to pair with this phone. Accept only if it shows this code:
pairing.pairedBody: This phone is now paired with {{desktop}}.

failed.codeExpired: The code expired. Show a new one on your computer and scan it within 2 minutes.
failed.codeUsed: That code was already used. Show a new one on your computer.
failed.codeInvalid: That code wasn't accepted. Show a new one on your computer and scan it again.
failed.refusedOnDesktop: Pairing was declined on the computer.
failed.locked: Too many pairing attempts. Wait 2 minutes and try again.
failed.tooManyDevices: Your computer already has 5 paired devices. Remove one in Settings › Devices first.
failed.wrongCertificate: Another device answered at that address, not your computer. Nothing was sent. Check that you're on your own Wi-Fi.
failed.unreachable: Couldn't reach your computer. Check that it's on, on the same Wi-Fi, and that the phone connection is on in Settings › Devices.
failed.protocol: Your computer answered in a way this app doesn't understand. Update the app or OXESpace on your computer.
